positive.point: Steve Kerr took accountability for wrongly blaming Will Richard for a turnover, showing leadership and responsibility.
Will Richard is seen as a valuable role player on a cost-effective contract, exceeding expectations as a rookie.

negative.point: There is frustration over perceived inconsistency in how Steve Kerr criticizes players, with Will Richard receiving more criticism than Podziemski and Draymond for similar mistakes.
The community is described as insufferable and filled with emotionally unstable individuals who lack knowledge of the game.
